reviews.comment: Professor Magat makes you care about the class because she is so passionate with her lectures. The class is hard and reading-heavy but I also learned a lot. She is very nice and caring about her students. She is very easy to talk to and gives extra credit as long as she sees that you work hard in the class. Very inspiring professor!

Do not take any course with this professor, but especially not POLS 325. She assigns at LEAST 4 readings (each being 20+) pages each week with a quiz over them on Wednesday. She explains nothing well. If you are taking 5 classes this is not the class for you because she doesn't care about what else you have going on. Plus, she grades very slowly.
